metrics.name: coop_rate_pd
metrics.description: Proportion of PD rounds where the player chose J (cooperate). Akata 2023 reports human cooperation around 0.55 against TFT in iterated PD; meta-analyses (e.g., Nowak 2006) report 0.40-0.65 against reciprocators.

metrics.name: coordination_rate_bos
metrics.description: Proportion of BoS rounds where player_action == opponent_action (any equilibrium reached). Camerer 2003 reports human coordination on coin-flip / alternation BoS bots around 0.55-0.65.

metrics.name: mean_payoff_pd
metrics.description: Mean per-round payoff in PD. Mutual cooperation (J,J) yields 8; mutual defection (F,F) yields 5; against TFT, sustained cooperation should converge to ~8 and sustained defection to ~5.

metrics.name: mean_payoff_bos
metrics.description: Mean per-round payoff in BoS. Coordinating on player-preferred F gives 10; opponent-preferred J gives 7; mismatch gives 0. Alternation against an alternating bot yields ~5 if perfectly anti-aligned, ~8.5 if perfectly aligned.

metrics.name: timeout_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of rounds in which no response was registered before the deadline.
